description: HR-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for Ambala, Haryana, serving as the first registration code in the state's series. It primarily handles vehicle registrations and licensing for the Ambala City and Ambala North areas, operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate office.
address: 1st Floor, Mini Secretariat, Ambala City, Haryana

description: HR-02 is the Regional Transport Office for Jagadhri in the Yamuna Nagar district of Haryana. This office is primarily responsible for the registration of private (non-transport) vehicles and issuing driving licenses within its jurisdiction.
address: SDM Office, Jagadhri, Yamuna Nagar, Haryana - 135003

description: HR-03 is the Regional Transport Office for Panchkula, Haryana, primarily responsible for the registration of non-transport (private) vehicles. Operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), it manages driving licenses and motor vehicle regulations for the northernmost district of Haryana.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (Civil), Mini Secretariat, Sector 1, Panchkula, Haryana

description: HR-04 is the official Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Naraingarh subdivision in Ambala, Haryana. It operates under the supervision of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and tax collections for its local jurisdiction.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Naraingarh, District Ambala, Haryana

description: The HR-05 RTO functions as the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Karnal sub-division in Haryana. It primarily handles the registration of non-commercial private vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses under the supervision of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM).
address: SDM Office, Mini Secretariat, Karnal, Haryana

description: HR-06 is the Regional Transport Authority (RTA) office located in Panipat, Haryana. It is the primary office for vehicle registration and driving license issuance within the Panipat district, a major industrial and historical hub. The office handles both private and commercial vehicle services under the Haryana Transport Department.

HR-07 is the Regional Transport Office located in Thanesar, serving the Kurukshetra district of Haryana. This office primarily handles the registration of non-commercial vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses for the subdivision, supporting the transport needs of this historically significant religious and cultural hub.

The HR-08 Regional Transport Office serves the Kaithal district in Haryana, facilitating vehicle registrations and driving license services. It is an active office located within the Mini Secretariat complex, catering to the transport needs of the local population.
address: SDM Office, Ground Floor, Mini Secretariat, Kaithal, Haryana

description: The HR-09 RTO serves the Guhla sub-division within the Kaithal district of Haryana. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and acts as the local Registering and Licensing Authority for private vehicles and driver licensing in the region.
address: SDM Office, Guhla, District Kaithal, Haryana - 136035

description: HR-10 is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Sonepat sub-division in Haryana. It is responsible for the registration of non-transport (private) vehicles, issuance of driving licenses, and the collection of road taxes for the local jurisdiction.

HR-11 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Gohana subdivision in the Sonipat district of Haryana. Operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), it manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and tax collection for vehicles within the Gohana administrative area.
address: SDM Office, Gohana, District Sonipat, Haryana

description: The HR-12 RTO serves the Rohtak district in Haryana, primarily handling the registration of private and commercial vehicles. It is centrally located in the Rohtak division and provides essential services like issuing driving licenses, vehicle fitness certificates, and road permits.
address: Regional Transport Office, Mini Secretariat, Rohtak, Haryana

description: The HR-13 RTO serves the Bahadurgarh sub-division in the Jhajjar district of Haryana, functioning under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office. It is responsible for various transport-related services including vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and tax collection. Bahadurgarh is a major industrial city on the border of Delhi, making this a high-traffic RTO office.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Bahadurgarh, Jhajjar District, Haryana

description: HR-14 is the Regional Transport Office (RTO) serving the city and administrative center of Jhajjar in Haryana. The office is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of transport laws under the Haryana Transport Department.
address: SDM Office Complex, Jhajjar Road, Jhajjar, Haryana

description: HR-15 is the Regional Transport Office code for Meham, located in the Rohtak district of Haryana. As a sub-divisional transport office (SDM), it facilitates vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the residents of Meham and nearby rural localities. It serves as a key administrative hub for motor vehicle regulations within the western part of the Rohtak division.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Office, Ground Floor, Meham, Haryana - 124112
